## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run verify` passes with no errors or warnings
- [ ] Tests cover the change (Rust tests, an e2e check, or `node e2e/codegen-e2e.mjs` for Copy as code)
- [ ] `DESIGN.md` is updated if the interface changed
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or personal data in the code, tests or screenshots
